## Decisions (with @rationale)

- `parallel({"mapping": {"i": "threadblock.x"}})` :: Map each row (i) to a distinct thread block (threadblock.x). LayerNorm is embarrassingly parallel across rows — each row
- `vectorize({"loop": "j", "width": 4})` :: Vectorize the inner j-loop with width 4 (float4 / 128-bit loads). N=2048 is divisible by 4, enabling coalesced 128-bit m
